name: Injoku
source:
The protagonist and his lover are assailed on return from a date.
He is forced to watch her attacker violate her.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ068075.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 主角和恋人约会归来时遭人袭击。他被迫眼睁睁看着袭击者凌辱自己的恋人。[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ068075.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
